text:
maria: Heads up — e2e perf gate on master is red after the merge from #pr-5182. p99 latency is ~25% higher than yesterday's baseline. Dashboard: https://perf.redwood.example/d/e2e-suite/nightly

sam: which pipeline/job is failing?

maria: job e2e-latency-nightly (id: e2e-latency-20260301-42). failure appears in the conversational p99 curve. link to run: https://ci.redwood.example/builds/42012

ci-bot: e2e-latency-nightly (e2e-latency-20260301-42) FAILED — gating rule: p99_latency > threshold (delta +24.8%)

deepa: can we get a rerun first? flaky infra sometimes. sam, can you kick a rerun?

sam: kicked rerun: `ci rerun --job e2e-latency-nightly --build 42012`  (triggered as build 42013) :zap:

deploy-bot: rerun started (build 42013) by sam

alex: quick datapoint — the last two merges touched kvcache batching and the sequence-length distribution change in telemetry. those often move p99. worth bisecting between 5f2a3c..b1d9e7

maria: agreed. deepa, can you try a quick git-bisect on the perf harness? if we can narrow to a single commit we can revert or fix fast.

deepa: starting local bisect now, reproducing with the stable perf workload. command I'm running:
```
git checkout master
git bisect start master 5f2a3c
# run e2e perf harness: ./eng/scripts/run_e2e_perf --suite conversational --warmup 2 --runs 3
```
I'll post results in ~30-45m.

jordan: pinging — your PR (#5182) touched batching logic, did you run the nightly perf suite locally?

jordan: I ran a microbenchmark but not full e2e nightly, sorry. looking now.

(30m later) deepa: bisect points to commit b1d9e7f — change to KV cache prefetching + small reordering in batcher. reproduces +22-27% p99 locally against baseline.

alex: that matches my suspicion. the reordering reduced early-token batching, increasing tail latency.

maria: can we try a canary revert of the reorder in a feature branch and run the nightly? if it fixes, we'll roll back and open a follow-up to implement prefetch without harming batching.

sam: created branch `revert/batcher-reorder-b1d9e7f` and queued e2e run (build 42015). link: https://ci.redwood.example/builds/42015

deploy-bot: build 42015 QUEUED

ci-bot: build 42015 RUNNING

(1h later) ci-bot: build 42015 PASSED — p99 within baseline +/- 1.5%

maria: great — that strongly implicates the reorder. jordan, can you open a revert PR so we can unblock master? please add notes about follow-up to preserve prefetch intent without hurting batching.

jordan: will do ASAP, PR draft up in 10m. sorry for the outage. :seedling:

sam: thanks team. I'll mark the gating incident resolved once revert PR merges and we see green on main overnight.

maria: optional next steps: add a perf regression test to the e2e harness that runs shorter but high-concurrency warmups to catch batching regressions faster. filing ticket after revert.

deepa: filing perf ticket: https://tracker.redwood.example/issue/INF-2193 — includes bisect notes and reproducer commands.

maria: awesome. closing loop here. :white_check_mark:
